regime_context: Canada/TSX shows broad rotation (14 of 16 themes eligible) with Base Metals & Copper as the clear momentum leader and Gold Miners a strong challenger. Durability is moderate, no crowding on leaders, and the absolute-trend gate has historically helped control drawdowns. However, the detector’s rank-IC is ~0 and direction accuracy is 50%, so this is a narrative/trend lens, not a return forecast.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff: if Gold Miners (XGD.TO) overtakes Base Metals in momentum rank and Gold Miners’ eligibility under the absolute-trend gate persists (i.e., stays eligible and durable), then the lean could shift. Until that happens, the leader remains Base Metals.
